data.exact_reserve_text: A detailed review by line of business has been performed. This has resulted in an explicit uplift to reserves to allow for anticipated claims inflation. Nevertheless, net reserve releases contributed a GBP 4.7m profit (Prior: n/a) for the year.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1254 received an inwards RITC (2017-2019) which created opening liabilities at 1 January 2022. During 2022 the gross provision for claims decreased by GBP 27.481m (a release), driven by favourable development on the transferred legacy business and reserve recalibrations despite management applying an explicit uplift for anticipated claims inflation. Net reserve releases contributed approximately GBP 4.7m to the 2022 profit. The legacy portfolio is concentrated in reinsurance acceptances across Casualty, Property, Marine, Energy, Motor and Aviation.
raw_causal_phrases: explicit uplift to reserves to allow for anticipated claims inflation
net reserve releases contributed a GBP 4.7m profit (Prior: n/a) for the year.
there may be considerable delays before current inflation manifests itself in future claim payments
A detailed review by line of business has been performed.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: This is the Syndicate's first year of operation and opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2022 is shown as zero prior to the inwards RITC. An inwards RITC (Syndicate 2689 2017-2019) added GBP 75.257m gross liabilities effective 1 Jan 2022. The prior year movement used here is the gross 'Change in the provision for claims in the year' from the technical reserves reconciliation: a gross release of GBP 27.481m. Percentage movement cannot be calculated because opening gross claims was zero. No disaggregated prior-year reserve movements by line of business were provided.
